interest: Shows consular posts using patriotic events—July 4th, the 1932 Washington Bicentennial, a 1935 Vice Presidential reception—to cultivate Japanese ties.
overview: Docket sheets for file 894.463 (1931-1935) list consular receptions and celebrations in Taihoku, Nagoya, Kobe, and Yokohama, including July Fourth events, the 1932 Washington Bicentennial, and a 1935 Oriental Hotel reception for the Vice President and a Congressional delegation.

people.name: George Washington
people.role: First President of the United States (honoree of bicentennial celebrations)

people.name: Gilbert Stuart
people.role: American portrait painter (referenced in relation to his portrait of Washington)
